custom_summary: Data Quest health check: ingestion freshness, BLS source freshness, last pipeline outcome, Gold completeness.
custom_description: Triggered when ops_pipeline_health reports one or more issues. See the issues column for the reason.
query_text: SELECT status, issue_count, array_join(issues, ' | ') AS issues, hours_since_ingestion_check, days_since_bls_published, last_pipeline_state, last_successful_refresh_at FROM workspace.data_quest.ops_pipeline_health
